items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: we had a boy by the name of R.T.

ctx.x: That's right. A little short, but he had—he had a full—he had a full-size bass. We used to laugh at him when he took his bass down.
But who was the bass player with the Nola band?
Uh, I'm trying to call this—we had a boy by the name of R.T. That's a— R.T. That's all right. R.T., yeah.
